newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey, Eurocopter to make 30 Cougar helicopters.
newsitem.headline: Turkey, Eurocopter to make 30 Cougar helicopters.

text.p: Turkey is to sign an agreement on Thursday with French-German helicopter group Eurocopter for the joint production of 30 Cougar carrier helicopters, Turkish defence officials said.
"Twenty of the 30 Cougars will go to the army and 10 others will go to the interior ministry," defence ministry spokesman Kemal Baglum told Reuters.

Turkish newspapers said the deal was worth $500 million, with around 30 percent local input. Production would take place at a plant near Ankara. The papers said Ankara was also to sign an agreement for four Sikorsky Sea Hawk helicopters this week.
"The news stories are true," another defence official said.
Eurocopter is 70 percent held by French state-owned Aerospatiale and 30 percent owned by Germany's Daimler-Benz Aerospace.
NATO member Turkey, a major arms buyer, makes extensive use of helicopters in its fight against Kurdish guerrillas in the mountainous southeast.
